aspect: equally spaced parallel lines deep to a strong reflector
cause: sound bouncing between two strong reflectors (or reflector and transducer)

aspect: short bright tapering trail behind a tiny strong reflector or gas
cause: reverberations too close to resolve (comet tail) or resonating gas bubbles (ring-down)

aspect: duplicate placed deeper than a strong specular reflector, e.g. the diaphragm
cause: the beam is redirected by the reflector; the system assumes a straight path

aspect: dark band deep to a strongly attenuating or reflecting structure
cause: strong attenuation or reflection: stone, bone, gas

aspect: bright band deep to a weakly attenuating structure
thin shadow from the curved edge of a round structure
cause: refraction and divergence at the curved surface
oblique incidence on a speed boundary (Snell)

aspect: off-axis echoes placed on the main beam axis
cause: energy outside the main beam; grating lobes come from arrays

aspect: reflector shown too deep or too shallow; step-off of a straight line
cause: true speed differs from the assumed 1540 m/s
finite beam width in the elevational plane
echo returns after the next pulse is sent (PRF too high for depth)
